run_test_script_with_kwargs: run the _TestScript.main with keyword arguments like foo=test to get parsed options
run_test_script_with_args: run the _TestScript.main with CLI-style args like --foo test to get parsed options
get_test_script_help: get the help text from _TestScript.help to see available arguments and description
register_custom_script: register a custom ParlaiScript subclass using the script.register_script decorator with a name
run_superscript_main: run script.superscript_main with a subcommand name and args to execute registered scripts
